_fixture: FROZEN FIXTURE - MUST FIRE. Three F4 defects in one ledger. 'dead-ratchet-check' is paired with a baseline tolerance of 1.0 AND NO RECORDED REASON, which puts its regression floor at ZERO - and since BLIND already claims everything at or below zero, its REGRESSED verdict is structurally unfirable: it could drop to 1 examined row and still report ok. That is the ACCIDENT case. It is deliberately distinct from a DECLARED exemption: audit-ff-carry also runs at 1.0, correctly, because its denominator is INVERSE (it counts EMPTY FF terms, so it falls when the pull improves) and it carries a written reason - a ratchet there would fire at whoever fixed the thing it watches. 'shrunk-check' examines far less than its baseline, proving -Accept does NOT silently lower a high-water mark: doing that on one capped run would have moved audit-ff-carry's floor from 464 to 40 and baked in a 91% coverage loss forever. 'unjustified-check' overrides the default tolerance with no reason, which is how a threshold drifts loose with nobody able to say whether it was ever measured. NEVER regenerate from the live ledger.

dead-ratchet-check.detail: a check whose tolerance makes its own ratchet unfirable, with nothing recording that as deliberate

shrunk-check.detail: a check that examined far less than its baseline this run

unjustified-check.detail: a check whose tolerance override carries no reason
